title: Conduvera GateDescriptor (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Public, non-authoritative descriptor of one Conduvera gate. A descriptor DECLARES planning and evidence semantics only; it never decides, executes, or carries any gate outcome (authority stays in conduvera-core). Identity rule: (gate_id, version [semantic_version], authority_domain) is the unique gate-definition identity - the protocol rejects two independent gate definitions claiming the same triple (enforced by the protocol test kit as the identity-collision rule).

version.description: Semantic version of THIS gate definition (semantic_version in the identity triple).

semantic_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical semantic content of this gate definition; changes whenever planning-relevant semantics change.

category.description: Free-form semantic category label (e.g. static-analysis, architecture-debt).

gate_family.description: V2.1 first-class gate family; architecture and SSoT capabilities are named families, never absorbed into generic lint/tests.

authority_domain.description: Authority domain the gate belongs to; part of the unique identity triple.

applies_when.description: Relevance declaration (changed paths, change classes, risk levels). Empty object means always relevant.

required_assurance_class.description: Assurance class this gate must run under; LOCAL_ADVISORY and MANAGED_AUTHORITATIVE results are never merged and never share an execution key.

timeout.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds for one execution.

side_effects.description: Typed side-effect declaration; 'none' is the minimum and the default expectation for pure gates.

output_schema.description: Declared output/evidence schema identifier ($id or relative schema reference) the gate's evidence must validate against.

canonical_source_refs.description: V2.1: canonical sources this gate's semantics were extracted from (exact files/commits); empty only for genuinely new gates.

architecture_contract_refs.description: V2.1: architecture contracts / ADRs this gate enforces or is bound by.

non_regression_basis.description: V2.1: how regression is judged - exact-base non-regression, absolute limits, dual policy, or not applicable.

semantic_review_trigger.description: V2.1: conditions under which this gate requires an independent semantic review (P5).

input_subjects.description: V2.1: subjects this gate evaluates; required gates evaluate ONLY candidate/diff-relevant inputs.

required_when_relevant.description: V2.1: when applies_when matches, the gate is required (true) or advisory (false); required gates may never be silently weakened or dropped.

excludable.description: V2.1: whether policy may exclude this gate at all; non-excludable gates (e.g. secret scan) are false.
